diagnostic_fields.condition: the governing contract fixes an exact stable code
diagnostic_fields.wording: diagnostic_code is normative when the governing contract fixes an exact stable code.

diagnostic_fields.condition: the governing contract or a ratified family rule fixes a canonical phase identifier
diagnostic_fields.wording: diagnostic_phase is normative only when the governing contract or a ratified family rule fixes a canonical phase identifier.

diagnostic_fields.condition: a ratified span-selection rule fixes its source-origin rule
diagnostic_fields.wording: primary_span is normative only when a ratified span-selection rule fixes its source-origin rule. For 1.20, this currently includes UNBOUND-LOOKUP-1 for E300.

ratified_span_selection_rules.source_origin_rule: the original-source occurrence whose lookup first fails under the specified evaluation order

advisory_fields.retention: are retained in raw observations and receipts
advisory_fields.conformance: cannot independently establish conformance or nonconformance

unknown.meaning: the contract or evidence does not determine the field
unknown.comparison: unknown is not a wildcard value that automatically matches an observation; a comparison with no normative mismatch and at least one undetermined normative value is unknown
